skill.name: scientific-schematics
skill.description: Generate scientific diagrams with OpenRouter-hosted image and review models. The workflow saves versioned images, scores quality, and refines prompts when thresholds are missed.
skill.summary: Generate and review scientific diagrams for papers, posters, and presentations.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, placeholder key names, documentation links, and test code. Confirmed risks include OpenRouter data transmission, plaintext credential guidance, broad ancestor .env loading, and API-key exposure in child-process arguments.

remediation.issue: The wrapper places the OpenRouter API key in child-process arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the key only through the child environment, remove the --api-key option, and avoid converting environment secrets into argv values.

remediation.issue: The loader searches several parent directories for .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Load only an explicitly selected file or the current project file. Do not traverse ancestor directories for credentials.

remediation.issue: Documentation prints keys and persists them in shell startup or project files.
remediation.suggestion: Remove key-printing commands. Recommend a secure secret manager or session-scoped environment variable, with restrictive permissions and version-control exclusion.

remediation.issue: Generation prompts and review images are transmitted to OpenRouter.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose external processing before execution and advise users not to submit confidential, regulated, or unpublished material without authorization.

content.value_statement: Complex scientific concepts are difficult to present clearly in publication figures. This skill generates, reviews, and refines labeled diagrams for defined document standards.
actual_capabilities: Generates scientific diagram images from natural-language descriptions.
Supports flowcharts, system architectures, neural networks, circuits, and biological pathways.
Applies document-specific quality thresholds for journals, posters, presentations, and other formats.
Reviews generated images with a separate vision model.
Refines prompts and regenerates images when review scores miss the selected threshold.
Saves versioned images and a review log containing scores and critiques.
limitations: Requires an OpenRouter API key, network access, and available model credits.
Generated scientific content can contain factual, labeling, or layout errors.
Produces raster images rather than editable vector diagrams.
Limits refinement to two generation iterations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Manuscript Figures
use_cases.description: Create a labeled study flowchart or conceptual figure for expert review before journal submission.

use_cases.title: Explain Model Architecture
use_cases.description: Visualize neural network components, data flow, and attention connections for technical reports or presentations.

use_cases.title: Teach Complex Pathways
use_cases.description: Generate accessible biological or systems diagrams with clear labels, direction, and color constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Flowchart
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a top-to-bottom flowchart for [process]. Include [steps] with short labels and directional arrows. Use a clean white background.

prompt_templates.title: Map a System Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a left-to-right architecture diagram for [system]. Show [components], data flows, interfaces, and boundaries. Target a presentation audience.

prompt_templates.title: Illustrate a Scientific Pathway
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a journal-quality pathway diagram for [pathway]. Label [entities], activation, inhibition, and compartment boundaries. Use colorblind-friendly redundant encoding.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Constrained Study Figure
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [document type] figure for [study]. Preserve these exact labels: [labels]. Show counts, exclusions, uncertainty, and legend details. Review scientific accuracy carefully.

output_examples.input: Create a CONSORT flowchart with screening, exclusions, randomization, follow-up, and analysis counts.
output: A versioned participant-flow image with labeled stages and directional connectors.
A review log containing the quality score, critique, and refinement decision.

output_examples.input: Create a presentation diagram of a transformer encoder-decoder with attention connections.
output_examples.output: A raster architecture figure showing encoder and decoder stacks, attention blocks, labeled inputs, outputs, and data flow.

output_examples.input: Create a journal figure showing the EGFR to ERK signaling pathway.
output_examples.output: A labeled pathway image with compartment boundaries, phosphorylation steps, activation arrows, inhibition marks, and a colorblind-friendly palette.

best_practices: Specify every required component, relationship, label, and direction in the initial prompt.
Select the document type that matches the final publication or presentation context.
Verify scientific accuracy, labels, accessibility, and publisher requirements before using any generated figure.
anti_patterns: Do not submit vague requests that omit the diagram type, components, or relationships.
Do not treat the model review score as proof of scientific correctness.
Do not send confidential or regulated material to OpenRouter without authorization.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The scripts require an OpenRouter API key with access to the configured image and review models.

faq.question: Where is my content processed?
faq.answer: Prompts and generated images are sent to OpenRouter for image generation and quality review.

faq.question: Which diagrams can it create?
faq.answer: It supports flowcharts, neural networks, system architectures, circuits, biological pathways, and other scientific schematics.

faq.question: How does refinement work?
faq.answer: A review model scores each image. The skill improves the prompt and regenerates only when the score misses the selected threshold.

faq.question: Does the quality score guarantee scientific accuracy?
faq.answer: No. A domain expert must verify facts, relationships, labels, units, and publication requirements.

faq.question: Can it produce editable vector graphics?
faq.answer: No. The included workflow generates raster image files and a separate review log.
